newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stock prices gain, index just below peak.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stock prices gain, index just below peak.

text.p: Latvian stock prices gained more ground and turnover advanced on Tuesday, ahead of more company results and new listings, dealers said.

Total market turnover was 165,000 lats and the Rietumu Bank market index grew 0.51 percent to 153.1, only slightly below its January peak. The Saules Bank Saule10 index, which tracks the bourse's 10 most active listings, gained 0.40 percent to 154.22.
"More company results are due and Valmiera Fibreglass factory will be quoted on the exchange in two or three weeks' time," one dealer said.
"People were simply fed up with marking time and decided to move," he added.
The central depository earlier said it would register the shares of Valmiera Fibreglass, the first step in becoming a quoted company.
Market leader Unibanka registered an all-time high of 3.30 lats versus 3.28 as it turned over 28,700 lats.

Kaija fish cannery, a secondary list stock, was the most traded on volume of 56,200 lats and it slipped three santimes to 2.20 lats. Daugavpils Chain factory was among the leaders with turnover of 38,900 lats as it added five santimes to 2.33 lats.
Mangali Shipyard was also active as it saw 5,300 lats' worth of shares change hands and it remained stable at 1.10 lats.
Elsewhere on the official list, Riga Transport Fleet traded 8,600 lats and slipped one santime to 1.68 lats and Staburadze rose four santimes to 2.60 lats on volume of 3,800 lats.
Ventspils fish cannery rose 18 santimes or 15 percent to 1.38 lats on volume of 3,000 lats.
The Lode Brick maker fell four santimes to 2.05 lats and it turned over 3,300 lats' worth of shares while Salacgriva fish cannery traded a small 700 lats as it rose 15 santimes to 4.95 lats.
